dryerArchitectures.name: Industrial Continuous 6-Magnetron Vacuum Belt Dryer (72 kW, 2.45 GHz, 20–100 mbar, 150 kg/h)
dryerArchitectures.classification: Commercial Industrial Food & Extract Vacuum Microwave Dryer (IEC 60519-6 & OSHA 1910.97)
dryerArchitectures.description: Continuous industrial multi-magnetron vacuum belt dryer engineered for high-value botanical extracts, fruit concentrates, and functional ingredients. Features 6 switch-mode 12 kW 2.45 GHz magnetron heads with isolated WR340 waveguides, 3-port ferrite junction circulators with closed-loop deionized water loads, and infrared pyrometer surface temperature feedback.

dryerArchitectures.name: High-Volume Modular Industrial Microwave Vacuum Tunnel (120 kW, 915 MHz, 10–80 mbar, 350 kg/h)
dryerArchitectures.classification: Heavy Commercial Bulk Dehydration & Starch Processing (IEC 60519-6 & NFPA 86)
dryerArchitectures.description: Large-scale continuous vacuum tunnel utilizing dual 60 kW industrial 915 MHz magnetrons. Long wavelength (32.8 cm vs 12.2 cm) delivers deep dielectric penetration into thick continuous product slabs without surface crusting, coupled with heavy-duty rotary vane vacuum pumps and roots blowers.

dryerArchitectures.name: Precision Pilot/Pharmaceutical Vacuum Microwave Belt Dryer (18 kW, 2.45 GHz, 15–50 mbar, 35 kg/h)
dryerArchitectures.classification: Sanitary Cleanroom Active Ingredient & Probiotic Dryer (FDA 21 CFR § 110 & 3-A Sanitary)
dryerArchitectures.description: Sanitary pharmaceutical-grade pilot vacuum microwave belt dryer for heat-sensitive probiotics, enzymes, and active botanicals. Equipped with solid-state microwave generators with sub-kilowatt power stepping, optical plasma arc detectors with 5-millisecond crowbar interlocks, and CIP wash nozzles.

dryerArchitectures.name: Aging Degraded Vacuum Microwave Dryer (Eroded Seals, Choked Water Load, Weak Circulator)
dryerArchitectures.classification: High-Risk Degraded Vacuum System (Severe Townsend Plasma Arcing & Magnetron Thermal Runaway)
dryerArchitectures.description: Sub-optimally maintained vacuum microwave dryer with degraded fluorocarbon vacuum door gaskets, calcified dummy water loads, eroded ferrite circulators, and miscalibrated arc suppression sensors. Highly vulnerable to spontaneous low-pressure Townsend glow discharges and product combustion.

foodProductProfiles.name: Thermolabile Berry Extract Concentrate (Anthocyanins & Vitamin C, 65% Initial Moisture)
foodProductProfiles.description: High-moisture berry extract rich in thermolabile anthocyanin antioxidants. Requires low-temperature vacuum evaporation (<52°C) under 35-50 mbar to prevent thermal pigment browning and loss of bioactivity.

foodProductProfiles.name: Bioactive Herbal / Botanical Extract (Polyphenols & Terpenes, 55% Initial Moisture)
foodProductProfiles.description: Viscous botanical herbal syrup formulated for nutraceutical tablets. Extreme sensitivity to localized microwave hotspot formation, as dry spots experience rapid drop in heat capacity and can char within seconds.

foodProductProfiles.name: High-Density Soluble Coffee Extract (Aroma Volatiles, 50% Initial Moisture)
foodProductProfiles.description: Concentrated coffee liquor requiring gentle moisture removal to retain volatile aroma esters and furans. Produces a highly porous, quick-dissolving glassy granule structure through gentle microwave vacuum puffing.

foodProductProfiles.name: Probiotic Dairy Hydrolysate & Peptide Slurry (Live Cultures, 70% Initial Moisture)
foodProductProfiles.description: Ultra-heat-sensitive peptide slurry containing live probiotic strains (Lactobacillus, Bifidobacterium). Chamber temperature must strictly stay below 42°C under deep vacuum (20-30 mbar) to ensure ≥90% microbial viability.

microwaveWaveguideConfigurations.name: WR340 Waveguide with 3-Port Ferrite Circulator & High-Flow DI Water Load (>25 dB Isolation)
microwaveWaveguideConfigurations.rating: Optimal (Provides complete magnetron cathode isolation and instant microsecond arc suppression)

microwaveWaveguideConfigurations.name: WR284 Waveguide with Fixed Resonant Iris & Standard Glycol Chiller Load (20 dB Isolation)
microwaveWaveguideConfigurations.rating: Acceptable (Standard industrial protection; vulnerable during severe vacuum arcing spikes)

microwaveWaveguideConfigurations.name: Degraded Waveguide with Defective Circulator & Calcified Water Load (<12 dB Isolation)
microwaveWaveguideConfigurations.rating: Dangerous (High reflected microwave energy returns directly into magnetron, inducing cathode overheating)
